**I. Preparation (Before the Inspection)**

1. **Start with the Maintenance Records:** This is your foundation.
    * **Review Previous Reports:**  Thoroughly examine historical inspection reports, repair records, and any previous maintenance notes.  Look for patterns of deterioration, recurring issues in specific locations, and the effectiveness of past repairs. Note dates of prior work and contractors involved.
    * **Review Design Drawings & As-Builts:** Understand the original design of the bridge and any modifications made since construction. Pay particular
